elif ((found_rplv == 0) and (plv > found_plv)) or
     ((found_rplv == 1) and (plv != found_plv)):
    SignalException(PPE)
grades.reason: The TLB translation pseudocode gives the check directly. If found_rplv is 0, access faults when the current PLV is greater than the entry's PLV, so any PLV at or below the entry's is allowed. If found_rplv is 1, access faults unless the current PLV equals the entry's PLV exactly. A failure raises the page privilege level illegal exception (PPE).
